package: ISO/IEC 42005 AI system impact assessment — sample record
disclaimer: Illustrative sample. No licensed standard text reproduced; clause identifiers only. No certification claimed.

system.name: Sample governed AI decisioning assistant
system.purpose: Assist human approvers in governance decisions; humans remain accountable.
system.autonomy: recommend-only; no autonomous consequential action without human approval

provenance: Phase 9 T292 sample fixture regenerated for GATE9; committed and present in the working tree.

assessment.obligationParaphrase: Identify potential impacts on individuals, groups, and society.
assessment.finding: Potential for biased recommendations; mitigated by human accountability and audit.

assessment.obligationParaphrase: Determine affected stakeholders and their exposure.
assessment.finding: Stakeholders: data subjects in evidence, approvers, auditors.

assessment.obligationParaphrase: Assess data handling and privacy implications.
assessment.finding: Data minimization + retention gaps surfaced explicitly; erasure via signed disposition.

assessment.obligationParaphrase: Record mitigations and accepted residual impact.
assessment.finding: Residual risks accepted at documented level; reviewed each release.
